history_eduOur legacy

Built on experience and personal service.

Led by Murari Lal Sharma, Ramam Gems serves customers from Jaipur with gemstone sourcing, consultation and supply support. Every enquiry starts with understanding the stone, purpose, specifications and order requirements.

Direct consultation

Discuss stone type, cut, size, quantity and intended use.

Flexible order support

Individual requirements, bulk orders and international enquiries.

Jaipur-based

Visit the business at Goverdhanpuri, Galta Gate.

Easy contact
